description: Canonical Supabase Auth config for the Morsel stack (issue #78). Mirrors the Management API auth-config keys (GET/PUT /v1/projects/{ref}/config/auth). Values here are NOT secrets. The SMTP password (the Resend API key) is deliberately absent: it is a secret VALUE that lives only in the local store under the name RESEND_API_KEY_MORSEL and is supplied by the operator at apply time via that environment name.
